summary: The change clears stale group status on custom multiline paste and row removal, and updates the project card dirty badge directly after the paste path rebuilds rows.

evidence: public/admin_projects.js:151 clears the group status when a multiline custom paste rebuilds rows.
public/admin_projects.js:222 calls updateSaveState(article) directly after custom paste, so the card badge recomputes without a native input event.
public/admin_projects.js:209 clears the group status after row removal, while the existing click listener at line 521 recomputes the badge.
public/admin_projects.js:517 passes the project article into wireRows, enabling the direct paste dirty-state update.
